notes: 25 candidates reviewed from saved Common Crawl text only (CC-MAIN-2025-43 captures). Institutions by host kept for all; none plainly belongs to another institution. Program-list pages: Haas Management of Organizations placements (strong: names, years, dissertations, employers; micro/macro OB and strategy, area to be classified). Buffalo alumni-success pages (index, grad-year-des page 2, last-name-des page 2) and the UConn alumni A-Z index are weak school-wide alumni feature listings mixing BS/MS/MBA with a handful of PhD alumni; they give names and PhD years only, no area or first job, and the PhD filter view of Buffalo (filters/phd) was not in this batch. UCI ITS pages are individual transportation PhD dissertation records (some OR-flavoured: Kang 2013, Lloret-Batlle 2017, Oh 2001, Mattingly 2000) but state no department; marked not-a-list as transportation/civil engineering/planning, an integrator may revisit if UCI civil engineering transportation is in scope; ITS also has a 'PhD Graduates' page not in this batch. Basel GSBE dissertations page captured as a JavaScript shell with no names. Cambridge ESD pages are MPhil (master's).
